title: amocvocab draft (staging)
description: Working superset of amocvocab: every standardised short name served by the arrays, with a review_status and the observed per-array state. NOT published. Entries graduate into amocvocab.yml when review_status is 'ready' (validated strictly at that point by validate_draft). Loose by design so unreviewed stubs and in-progress decisions are valid.

generated_from.description: How the observed fields were seeded (e.g. inventory of amocatlas/metadata).

review_status.description: Lifecycle: unreviewed (auto-seeded stub) -> draft (decisions in progress) -> ready (`entry` complete, validated strictly, eligible to graduate) -> published (already lives in amocvocab.yml; not edited here). Only 'ready' entries are strict-checked and graduate.

served_by.description: Arrays that serve this short name (refreshed from the metadata inventory; do not hand-edit).

observed.description: What the per-array metadata YAMLs currently say for this short name (refreshed from inventory; do not hand-edit).

standard_names.description: Distinct standard_names across arrays (null = omitted / Case C).

conflict.description: True if arrays disagree on standard_name or units.

notes.description: Working notes / open questions for this short name.

entry.description: The in-progress amocvocab quantity for this short name. Free-form while unreviewed/draft; validated against amocvocab.schema.json #/$defs/quantity (plus CF-name and UDUNITS checks) by validate_draft once review_status is 'ready'.
